title: COA flags Sandiganbayan's P11.9M foreign travel advances, ‘expensive’ seminar venues
summary: The Commission on Audit (COA) flagged P11.87 million in cash advances for foreign trips by Sandiganbayan officials, citing incomplete supporting documents in its 2025 annual audit report.
